OpenAI launches GPT-6 with built-in agent mode

OpenAI on Monday released GPT-6, a new model that can carry out multi-step tasks across business software such as CRMs, spreadsheets and email without a human clicking through each screen.

The company said early enterprise customers used the agent mode to reconcile invoices, qualify inbound sales leads and draft customer follow-ups, cutting routine admin work by hours each week.

Pricing for the API is 40 percent lower than the previous generation, the company said, which makes automation viable for smaller businesses that previously found the costs prohibitive.

Analysts cautioned that the agent still makes mistakes on unfamiliar interfaces and recommended human review for payments and anything customer-facing.
